description: This is a PHP source file defining an API controller class for handling sale payment methods in the OpenCart project. It includes methods for retrieving available payment methods and saving the selected payment method, with relevant validation and response handling.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Controller class for API managing sale payment methods, extending the base OpenCart Controller.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Retrieves available payment methods based on the current cart and session, responding with JSON data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the selected payment method into session data after validating the input and updates the session accordingly.
